verdict.rationale: Chroma's docs have a dedicated integrations/frameworks section. It includes a LangChain integration page covering question answering over documents and LangChain-blog material, plus an official MCP server integration that lets agents such as Claude use Chroma for search and persistent memory. That covers the core of plugging Chroma into RAG and agent frameworks. Missing for 10: any evidence of a LlamaIndex or other named framework integration, evidence that the integrations are actively maintained, in-depth integration docs beyond brief snippets, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the integrations.
